spec-01-c3.text: Northwestern University IMSERC. Protein NMR guide (eNMR), NOE section. Northwestern University Integrated Molecular Structure Education and Research Center.
spec-01-c3.quote: NOEs usually are observed only for proton pairs separated by 5-6 A.
spec-01-c3.claim: NOE intensities scale as r−6, which turns 2D NOESY spectra into a distance ruler used to determine solution structures of proteins

spec-05-c3.text: Nie S, Emory SR (1997). Probing Single Molecules and Single Nanoparticles by Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering. Science (New York, N.Y.).
spec-05-c3.quote: Optical detection and spectroscopy of single molecules and single nanoparticles have been achieved at room temperature with the use of surface-enhanced Raman scattering.
spec-05-c3.claim: enough for single-molecule SERS first reported by Nie and Kneipp in 1997

spec-06-c1.text: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences (2002). The Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2002: Press release. NobelPrize.org.
spec-06-c1.quote: In the method that John B. Fenn published in 1988, electrospray ionisation (ESI), charged droplets of protein solution are produced which shrink as the water evaporates.
spec-06-c1.claim: Electrospray ionization (ESI), the 2002 Nobel-winning Fenn technique

spec-06-c2.text: Makarov A (2000). Electrostatic axially harmonic orbital trapping: a high-performance technique of mass analysis. Analytical chemistry.
spec-06-c2.quote: This work describes a new type of mass analyzer which employs trapping in an electrostatic field.
spec-06-c2.claim: The Orbitrap (Makarov, 2000; commercialized by Thermo Fisher as Exactive, Q Exactive, Orbitrap Eclipse, Orbitrap Astral)

spec-10-c3.text: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences (2023). The Nobel Prize in Physics 2023: Press release. NobelPrize.org.
spec-10-c3.quote: Pierre Agostini, Ferenc Krausz and Anne L’Huillier have demonstrated a way to create extremely short pulses of light that can be used to measure the rapid processes in which electrons move or change energy.
